requirements: Listing is exclusively for SaaS products
Vendor portal access is granted via a secure link emailed after the initial form
Team reviews the submission and approves on validation
preparation: Product name, URL, description, logo, screenshots, pricing model and category
Company details including funding status (form asks about funding/funds received)
A company-domain email, or ability to place an HTML snippet on the site, for product verification
workflow: Open https://www.saasworthy.com/addproduct and complete the initial form
Watch for the emailed secure link to the vendor portal (check spam)
Complete all required profile details in the portal and submit for verification
Team reviews and approves the listing
Optionally verify the product (free) via company email or HTML snippet — verified listings unlock featuring eligibility
Re-confirm details quarterly when the reminder email arrives to keep verification
watchFor: Verification is free but recurring — a quarterly email asks you to re-confirm details or the verified state lapses
Homepage 'Curated Collections' featuring is a paid/sponsored promotion, not part of the free listing
Main site returned 403 to automated fetches — use .us mirror pages (saasworthy.us) for docs if blocked
Getting featured requires being approved, verified, and listing competitors the product could replace
countsAsLive: An approved product profile page on saasworthy.com reachable via category/search listings.
unknowns: Exact fields on the /addproduct form (main site blocked automated reads)
Whether free listings carry dofollow links (third-party guides claim dofollow; not confirmed on-site)
